purpose: Split every oversized authored source/test/benchmark by responsibility, preserving runtime ownership and APIs. Readability refactor, not an algorithm or speedup claim.

validation.full_sdk_failure: Original artifact exact-atime download assertion at tests/test_artifacts.py:233. Artifact implementation and precision assertion byte-identical to frozen baseline; previously demonstrated uncontrolled external-access interference remains blocked, not resolved or hidden.
validation.python_lint_and_format: All changed Python sources pass existing Ruff checks and format.
validation.benchmark_cli: 18 fresh-process alternating trials, same build profile, frozen old SDK/native versus extracted new wheel, CPU23; no tests/builds overlap measurement.
validation.benchmark_scope: Short functional/performance smoke of split harness, not a statistically conclusive performance campaign. Every physical metric row/step/field/value checked.

environment.gc: enabled; collected before each measured batch
environment.io: warm OS page cache; no fsync; final buffer drain included
environment.memory: fresh-process Linux RSS, including native allocations

tradeoffs: More files/import declarations; does not reduce total implementation or state.
HistoryWrites is a state-sharing mixin, not another owner/adapter object; legacy serialization remains on HistoryStore to preserve module-level encode_line hooks.
Short-smoke default/backend/span median means move by roughly +1%; variation and sample length do not establish a causal slowdown or universal no-impact guarantee. No speedup claimed.
Internal defining modules and test file paths change; public import locations and native exports remain available, and original test names/parametrizations are preserved.
